title: TripAdvisor Reviews

hotelNames.title: Hotel names
hotelNames.description: Hotel names, ideally with the city, e.g. ["Memmo Alfama Hotel, Lisbon", "The Savoy London"]. Use for "reviews of hotel X". Resolved through TripAdvisor's own typeahead; a hit must share at least half of your words, so a name TripAdvisor does not know ends as a free error row, never as a random hotel — check hotel_name in the hotel and status rows. Empty (default) = none; one of hotelNames, startUrls or locationIds is required.
hotelNames.sectionDescription: Hotel names, TripAdvisor hotel URLs and/or location ids (the d<number> in a URL). At least one; a URL, its id and its name are read and billed once.

startUrls.title: TripAdvisor hotel URLs
startUrls.description: TripAdvisor hotel pages on any TripAdvisor country site, e.g. ["https://www.tripadvisor.com/Hotel_Review-g189158-d4509998-Reviews-Memmo_Alfama_Hotel-Lisbon.html"]. Only the numeric d<id> matters: a wrong geo id or slug still resolves. Restaurant and attraction URLs are rejected before anything is charged (use kestrel/tripadvisor-restaurant-reviews for those). Empty (default) = none.

locationIds.title: TripAdvisor location ids
locationIds.description: TripAdvisor location ids, the number after "d" in a hotel URL, e.g. ["4509998", "d188150"] — what an earlier run's location_id gives you. The fastest path (no lookup) and the way to re-read the same hotels on a schedule. An unknown id ends as status not_found and costs nothing. Empty (default) = none.

maxReviewsPerHotel.title: Max reviews per hotel and language
maxReviewsPerHotel.description: The main cost control: the newest N reviews per hotel and language are read, e.g. 50 (default 100, maximum 20000), at most N × $0.005 ($0.50 at the default). 0 = every review the site lists (10 per page; popular hotels run into the thousands). Filters apply AFTER this cap: 100 with maxRating 2 delivers only the low-rated reviews among the newest 100, so pair a filter with 0 or with sinceDate when the user wants all of them.
maxReviewsPerHotel.sectionDescription: How many reviews per hotel and language, and which ones. TripAdvisor lists reviews newest first; every filter here runs before billing, after the maxReviewsPerHotel cap.

sinceDate.title: Only reviews published on or after
sinceDate.description: Only reviews published on or after this date: "2026-06-01", or relative so a schedule never goes stale: "30 days", "2 weeks", "6 months". Reviews come newest first, so reading stops once a whole page is older — a daily run with "2 days" reads one or two pages per hotel and bills only the new reviews. Empty (default) = no date limit. Use for "new reviews only" and review monitoring.

maxRating.title: Only reviews at or below this rating
maxRating.description: 0 (default) = every rating. 1-5 = keep only reviews with that many bubbles or fewer, e.g. 2 for a complaints feed ("negative reviews only"), 3 to include the middling ones. Filtered reviews are never billed; the pages are still read. Applied to the reviews read under maxReviewsPerHotel, so use maxReviewsPerHotel 0 or a sinceDate for a complete list of negative reviews.

tripTypes.title: Trip types
tripTypes.description: Keep only reviews from these trip types, e.g. ["business"] or ["family", "couples"]; allowed: family, couples, solo, business, friends. Empty (default) = all trip types. Filtered reviews are never billed. Use for "what do business travellers say about hotel X".

languages.title: Review languages
languages.description: Availability: the zh site failed live checks on 2026-10-16; Chinese collection is currently unverified. Use ["en"] for the tested example. Each language selects a TripAdvisor country site, not a translation target. includeTranslated=false keeps original reviews; filters apply after maxReviewsPerHotel. Each language is a separate job and bill, and translated duplicates can recur across languages. See README for supported site codes.
languages.sectionDescription: Each TripAdvisor country site serves the reviews in its own language, machine translations included.

includeTranslated.title: Include machine-translated reviews
includeTranslated.description: true (default) = keep the machine-translated reviews each site shows (rows carry translated: true and original_language). false = only reviews written in that site's language — with several languages this also stops one review being billed once per language. Use false for "French reviews written by French guests".

requireText.title: Only reviews with a written text
requireText.description: true = drop rating-only reviews before billing. false (default) = keep them. TripAdvisor reviews almost always carry text, so this rarely removes much.

includeHotelRow.title: Include a hotel row
includeHotelRow.description: true (default) = also emit one free row per hotel and language (type "hotel"): bubble rating, review count, reviews per rating and per language, six sub-rating averages, city ranking ("#33 of 372 hotels in Lisbon"), address, coordinates, phone, website, amenities. Never charged. false = review and status rows only.

sessions.title: Parallel sessions
sessions.description: Residential proxy sessions (egress IPs) reading in parallel, 1 to 16, e.g. 4 (default 2). More is faster for many hotels; each session is paced separately. Does not change the bill.
sessions.sectionDescription: Leave these alone unless a run is being throttled.

perIp.title: Requests per second per session
perIp.description: Requests per second per session, 0.1 to 3 (default 1). TripAdvisor serves about 1 page per second per IP; raising it causes IP rotations, not speed. Leave the default.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Keep the default: Apify Proxy, RESIDENTIAL group ({"useApifyProxy": true, "apifyProxyGroups": ["RESIDENTIAL"]}). TripAdvisor's bot gate refuses every datacenter IP, so any other proxy fails every page before anything is charged.

description: TripAdvisor hotel reviews. Minimal input: {"hotelNames": ["Memmo Alfama Hotel, Lisbon"]} — or startUrls / locationIds. Default = the newest 100 English reviews per hotel at $0.005 each (at most $0.50 per hotel) plus a free hotel row. maxReviewsPerHotel 0 = every review; sinceDate = new reviews only; maxRating 2 = complaints only (filtered reviews are free).
